name: 2036 S. Prairie Avenue — the alley building of the house at 2036 (district draft; refined by T-1937)

function.note: The 1911 sheet reads '2-storey brick stable (crossed) on the alley at the 21st Street end'. Drawn as a stable in 1911; the 1904 envelope is the 1911 one.

research_note: A DISTRICT DRAFT (T-2351, the owner's district pass of 2026-10-08): a serviceable first model, complete from the street, the walks, the alley and the air, that T-1937 refines in place under this same id. Written by tools/draft_prairie_1904.py from the sheet 35 trace (s35fp-2036-b2), the T-1842 census (s35-2036-rear) and the T-1837 register row frontage-35-063; every height, roof, opening and feature is the draft rules' reconstruction (data/components/prairie_1904/draft_prairie_1904.json; liberty L-draft-prairie-20-22-west-2351).

documented_range.note: The draft claims the 1904 target and no more: the 1911 sheet draws the building and the T-1842 census rules it present in 1904 (present_as_mapped). Its building and loss dates are the per-building ticket's to read.

position.symbolic_location: 2036 S. Prairie Avenue, parcel prairie_2036 (data/street_grid/1904.json), west side of Prairie Avenue, Prairie Avenue, 20th to 22nd Street (Sanborn 1911 vol. 3 sheet 35).
position.note: The rear corner of the main body's rectangle (lot frame u 1.000, v -5.500 m from the middle of the rear lot line), through the T-1250 fit of the sheet: the sheet's georeference carries no independent check: its own fit residual is 0.05 m RMS on its control crossings, a similarity on two degrees of freedom that says little away from them, plus about a pixel (0.19 m) of trace on this coarser copy. Rotation -0.632 degrees turns the plan's u axis onto the lot's own rear-to-street line.

derivation.reason: The four derivation methods re-derive from the 1835 files; this position is re-derived from the traced sheet and the 1904 parcel by tools/draft_prairie_1904.py --check instead.

draft_plan.note: Rectangles fitted inside the traced parts by the rules' fit (cell 0.25 m, at most 3 a part, to 90% cover): s35fp-2036-b2 outline (main, brick), rectangle 1 of that part; the part's rectangles cover 71% of its fill; s35fp-2036-b2 outline (main, brick), rectangle 2 of that part; the part's rectangles cover 71% of its fill. Roles: the main part's largest rectangle is the main body; a shallow rectangle at the front is a bay; the sheet's ranges, porches and stone fronts keep their roles. Storeys per piece and roof per piece are the draft rules' (reconstructed).

draft_elevation.note: RECONSTRUCTED by the draft rules, family row 'service' overlaid with the frontage row: The Ebenezer Buckingham house at the 21st Street corner (the register's 'mapped substantial brick house, basement, corner-facing elevation'): a low hip over the 3S.B. body with the sheet's bays as projections, the entrance central where the 1888 Inland Architect's portico stands. Its 6-ft walls along 21st Street are not drawn: the draft archetype has no boundary walls, and T-1911 builds them. Heights are the rules' starting values inside RECONSTRUCTION-RULES.md's ranges; bays, entrance side, chimneys and dormers are counts the family rules choose, and the seed 2891065020 only tints the fabric inside +-6 %. Liberty L-draft-prairie-20-22-west-2351.
